artist.name: GIRLS NIGHT OUT
artist.bio: Girls Night Out is the solo DJ project of Vijayant Singh, based in Delhi. He plays house, techno, disco and acid, and has played Magnetic Fields, Serendipity Arts Festival and Boxout Weekender. His Magnetic Fields Nomads profile also lists Boiler Room.

eras.sound: Wave, industrial, new beat, italo and left-field techno
80s and 90s house, disco, acid, balearic and soca
